changelog:
Initial public release of HTML Presentation Generator.

- Generates professional multi-page HTML presentations, each slide as a standalone HTML file (960×540 px).
- Supports cover, table of contents, section divider, various content pages (text/mixed/chart/etc.), and summary slides.
- All presentations use Times New Roman font for both Chinese and English.
- Built-in support for image generation, color palette selection, and visual verification of slides.
- Supports export to PDF/PPTX and final deployment of slide decks.
